unstuck_said.text: Filed proposal on pgalyen1987/gate402-mcp#4: a Nano (XNO) settle rail for the per-call tools. Argued per-call USDC-on-Base overhead is a real fraction of $0.002/$0.001 prices; Nano block-as-receipt removes L2/issuer/facilitator margin and makes the signed receipt the ledger. Proposed a rail field on existing tools + GPU escrow-on-success payout in XNO. Verdict await.
